description: This file defines the 'Release' class, a model representing release records in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes properties for release attributes, methods for retrieving release data, and utility functions for handling list view data and search clauses.

classes.name: Release
classes.description: A class representing a software release entity within SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean, with methods for data retrieval, display, and search functionality.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the release as its summary text.

methods.name: get_releases
methods.description: Retrieves a list of releases filtered by status and optional where clause, optionally including a blank entry.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Stub method for filling in additional list fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Stub method for filling in additional detail fields.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for list view display, including encoded name and status.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a generic SQL WHERE clause for searching release records by name.
